positions.description:

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, IBM Tivoli Monitoring for Virtual Environments (ITMfVE)
positions.description:
IBM Software Group, Development, RTP, NC
•	Designed and developed the Launch-in-Context feature of the ITMfVE Dashboard, a dashboard which presents the management information from several ITMfVE agents such as VMware VI agent, NetApp Storage agent, Linux Kernel-based Virtual Machines agent among others 
•	Interfaced with several other teams in order to perform Development and Quality Assurance tasks
•	Responsible for the development and maintenance of the ITMfVE’s System Director base agent 
•	Assisted in the design and development of the Linux Kernel-based Virtual Machines agent
•	Fixed several ITMfVE defects over several development cycles 
•	Performed several Quality Assurance tasks for the ITMfVE agents and Dashboard including Build Verification tests (BVT), System Verification tests (SVT) and Integration Verification tests (IVT), creating and managing several defects that I created
•	Drafted and reviewed some of the sections of the ITMfVE Dashboard User Guide 
•	Performed various Fagan code inspections for the Network Management Agent and other ITMfVE agents
•	Performed testing of IBM System P agents on LPARs ensuring that its data was propagated to the IBM Mashup Center as expected
•	Supported ITMfVE Beta by assisting existing and potential customers with questions

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, IBM Tivoli Monitoring for Energy Management (ITMfEM)
positions.description:
IBM Software Group, Development, RTP, NC                                                         

•	Responsible for the development of ITMfEM’s Systems Director Active Energy Manager 
      agent
•	Responsible for spearheading, creating and implementing test cases to test ITMfEM’s   
      Siemens APOGEE agent using IBM internal tools, which followed the Agile Development  
      Process
•	Performed several Quality Assurance tasks for the ITMfEM team including BVT, SVT, IVT 
      and Translation Verification tests (TVT), creating and managing several defects that I 
      created over the years
•	Interfaced with IBM Systems Group’s System Director team throughout my time with the 
      steam, in order to get several development tasks done
•	Performed several development tasks for other ITMfEM agents such as Eaton Power Xpert 
       agent, APC InfraStruXure agent and OPC Servers agent
•	Developed and tested some of the out-of-box reports for some of the ITMfEM agents

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, IBM Tivoli Common Reporting (TCR)
positions.description:
IBM Software Group, Development, RTP, NC                                                                            

•	Responsible for the designing and development of the logging component of the Tivoli  
Common Reporting using the BIRT engine and logging technologies
•	Performed several Quality Assurance tasks for the Tivoli Common Reporting team including 
      BVT, SVT, IVT and TVT, creating and managing several defects that I created over time
•	Assisted in interfacing and engaging other Tivoli teams in order to get them to embed our      
        reporting tool in their products

positions.title: Software Engineer/Staff Software Engineer, IBM Tivoli Event Management
positions.description:
IBM Software Group, Development, RTP, NC                                                                             

•	Performed functional verification (Quality Assurance) tests for several Tivoli Enterprise Console (TEC) 3.9.0 components on different platforms including HP-UX, Solaris, Linux, AIX and several Windows versions
•	Developed & maintained several new features of TEC 3.9.0 Java Console component
•	Delivered and facilitated the implementation of Director 5.2 Corporate Milestones ahead of schedule 
•	Fixed software bugs (APARS & defects) identified on the field (C, Java, ANT) for the Java Console   
User Interface Server components using several programming languages such as C, Java, C++, ANT among others – L3 assignment
•	Provided education/guidance to developers that needed to integrate their products with TEC 
•	Developed a Test (Quality Assurance) plan and document for the Configuration component of the Common Event Infrastructure
•	Performed functional verification tests for the Datastore component of the Common Event Infrastructure
•	Assisted with the design of Monitoring Agent for TEC especially the User Interface (UI) piece
•	Created several product prototypes  
•	Developed the workspaces, situations, take actions and other UI features for the agent
•	Fixed software bugs identified by testers of the product
•	Assisted with the design of the Active Event List integration piece for TEC. 
•	Created the prototype for the integration piece and implemented the integration of ITM’s Web portal with TEC’s Java Console
•	Provided education/guidance to the Information Development team and developed several training guides for the support team

positions.title: Business Analyst, Special Projects

•	Made recommendations for growth based on analysis findings

positions.title: Summer Analyst, IT Support Team
positions.description:
•	Reengineered existing Sybase-based Data Workbench reports using Perl and Sybase. Worked with a team on the pre-compilation, pre-installation, make-building, configuration and testing of an implementation of Common Object Request Broker Architecture (CORBA), ORBIX in a 3-tier environment – Solaris, Sybase and C++ at back-end, CORBA at middle tier and Visual Basic front-end
•	Developed and maintained Lifeline, a web-based application using Perl, JavaScript and Sybase as backend database. Worked as the Lifeline application personnel for all enterprise users of the application. Created reports based on results from stored procedures and SQL queries to a Sybase database. Wrote Korn and Bash scripts to configure system and automate processes on the system

patents.title: Method and system for filtering a table
patents.description: A method for filtering a table may include creating a filter in response to a user selecting data in a first table. The method may also include applying the filter to at least one other table in response to a user selecting at least one column in the at least one other table.

patents.title: Method, apparatus, and computer program product for an enhanced mouse pointer
patents.description: A method, apparatus, and computer program product are disclosed for selecting links in a page using an enhanced mouse pointer. The page is displayed in a data processing system that includes a mouse that includes a scroll wheel. Multiple links are included in the page. A standard mouse pointer is displayed in the page. An enhanced mouse pointer state is then invoked causing the standard mouse pointer to become an enhanced mouse pointer. In response to invoking the enhanced mouse pointer state, a closest one of the links in the page to the enhanced standard mouse pointer is determined. An enhanced mouse pointer indicator is displayed that extends from the enhanced mouse pointer to the determined closest one of the links. The links may be scrolled through by rotating the scroll wheel.
